about_the_game:
A Game Built by Voices, Not Just Developers

Your Move is a multiplayer game shaped by the Cozy Cabin community. Every weapon, feature, and location was suggested by players and brought to life by Andrew and Mason (The Team Behind Cozy Cabin Studios). Jump in with friends, explore wild ideas, and maybe even find your own name in the credits page.

Survive

Work together with other players to try to survive in an  eerie forest, where every shadow hides a secret and every sound could mean danger. As you explore, you’ll quickly realize that things may not be as they seem, and trusting what you see—or even who you’re with—could be the difference between survival and disaster.

Friends or Foes?

Not all players share the same goal. Some will stand by your side and help you survive, while others may secretly be plotting against you. After all, in order for there to be winners, there must be losers—and you won’t always know which side someone is truly on until it’s too late.

Features

  • Community-Driven Design: Every weapon, character, and mechanic starts as a suggestion from players.

  • Online Multiplayer: Choose to survive alongside trusted friends or take your chances with a group of total strangers—the decision is entirely yours, and it just might change the outcome of the game.

  • Deceit: What’s a great game without a little deception? Sometimes the only way to win is to trick, mislead, or betray your fellow survivors, all in the pursuit of making it out alive.

  • Harsh conditions: Stranded deep in the wilderness with no signs of civilization, you’ll face unforgiving environments and limited resources, forcing you to make difficult and often drastic choices to stay alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 or AMD 6700-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
